name: BigBlueButton
tagline: Open source web conferencing for online learning. Built for tutors and teachers.
shortDescription: BigBlueButton is an open source web conferencing platform built specifically for online learning. Whiteboard, breakout rooms, polls, shared notes, and an LMS integration layer.
longDescription:
## What it is

BigBlueButton is an open source web conferencing platform designed for online learning. Whiteboard, breakout rooms, polls, shared notes, hand-raise, emoji reactions, and an LMS integration layer (Moodle, Canvas, WordPress, etc.).

## Why we recommend it

If you need a video conferencing tool for online classes (not just meetings), BigBlueButton is purpose-built. The whiteboard, breakout rooms, polls, and shared notes are designed for teaching scenarios.

## When to use it

- Online tutoring and classes
- Webinars and training sessions
- Integration with an LMS (Moodle, Canvas)
- Replacing Zoom for education
installInstructions:
**Ubuntu install:**
```
wget -qO- https://ubuntu.bigbluebutton.org/bbb-install.sh | bash -s -- -v jammy-30 -s bbb.example.com -e info@example.com
```

Requires a dedicated Ubuntu 22.04 server with at least 4GB RAM, 4 cores.
pricingDetails: Free. LGPL licensed. Self-host on Ubuntu. Managed hosting available from partners.
